notes.title: 《紫塞秋风》新修版免费试玩今日上线！不同玩家试玩指引
notes.content:
勇闯西部武林，共赴丝路江湖。今日（1月31日），《紫塞秋风》新修版免费公开试玩于Steam正式上线！欢迎各位少侠前往体验！以下是针对《紫塞秋风》不同玩家的试玩指引：

※未拥有原作的玩家：于Steam商店搜索《紫塞秋风》或《紫塞秋风》新修版，进入商店页后，点击页面中的“下载”按钮即可游玩；
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/e0574af659155dda3e341f5b7bff1e9083d961ed.png[/img]
※已拥有原作的玩家：

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/7a8ecad29e8f9ca58658107a733064469f9018d8.png[/img]
（1）选中steam游戏库；
（2）选择《紫塞秋风》右键，弹出选项；
（3）选择属性选项；
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/49510cd2311a454e0c0998b2258f80b9a7d37645.png[/img]
（4）在弹出的属性窗口中选择测试版；
（5）点选参与测试中的下拉框；
（6）选择：demo-新修版；
（7）关闭窗口；
（8）成功选择版本后，游戏名称后会带上[demo]，并且游戏所需空间为3.55GB。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/80624d8cb670e7dfd6de2a8f2d0cb54b1dd26b41.png[/img]
特别注意：如果玩家已经安装了游戏本体，需在卸载游戏后切换分支进行游玩（重新安装游戏后可能不显示分支，还请玩家多加尝试与包容），在成功切换后，Steam库内会显示《紫塞秋风》【Demo】，即可正式游玩。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/28807f31ce5994fe7c4fc29fb66a72e023a36f5b.png[/img]

《紫塞秋风》新修版还在持续优化与打磨阶段，并非最终效果，我们十分期待各位少侠在Steam社区、官方QQ群等平台分享宝贵的建议与反馈，少侠在游玩过程中遇到了任何问题或BUG，也可以与我们反馈，我们会认真收集并吸纳调整。这都将帮助我们持续精进游戏的品质，让《紫塞秋风》再进一步。还请各位少侠多多包容、多多分享！

【游戏介绍】
《紫塞秋风》新修版在原作基础上进行了画质、UI以及视听体验的重制革新，并追加了丰富战斗体验的诸多游玩要素。包括即时战斗玩法、特色武学系统，以及悬疑剧情、多线解谜融为一体的西部之旅的全面进化，还原记忆中的《紫塞秋风》并带来更多惊喜！
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/2c6baad40753f685e07bd21f738046a68300f81d.jpg[/img]
苍莽大漠、盎然绿洲、独特西北建筑、神秘敦煌莫高窟…《紫塞秋风》打造了一个充满浓厚西北风味的武林江湖。《紫塞秋风》新修版提升了角色建模、场景以及光影效果等方面的画质水平，还重新制作了关卡地图中的地形，通过更加精美、丰富的环境氛围让玩家感受到身临其境的冒险体验！
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/1ef569cfb360a1667e15f30c0ad6c3825ab72657.jpg[/img]
作为一款即时战斗武侠ARPG游戏，《紫塞秋风》能让你感受真正的快意恩仇，新修版中玩家将面对全新的敌人和Boss，且原有敌人和Boss独特的动作和招式也进行了一定的改动，还开放了简易、普通和困难三种游戏难度级别供玩家选择。在给予玩家适当的难度来体验游戏的同时，鼓励玩家继续挑战更高难度。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/38b243c770ad8ad4870023c1061fa35e7327554c.png[/img]
高手过招从不拘泥于一招一式，丰富招式自由组合，随心所欲才称得上“侠客”之名。《紫塞秋风》新修版扩充了招式的升级内容，这需要玩家在自由探索与搭配的基础上进行能力的合理升级，此外还重制了内功修炼界面和内功玩法，玩家可选择打通不同的气门经脉获得更为多样化的能力加成。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/fb13cd20dc4bf0a2dc560fc4f6b71c2a74ef4afb.jpg[/img]
塞起秋风剑沙鸣，国产西部武侠题材ARPG《紫塞秋风》新修版免费公开试玩已于今日（1月31日）正式上线，悬疑、丝路、探索、武侠…...为大家带来更真实的即时战斗武侠体验！

notes.title: 久等了，来再战一轮吧！《紫塞秋风》新修版预告片发布，再探大漠苍莽
notes.content:
塞起秋风剑鸣沙，首款中国西部武侠游戏《紫塞秋风》焕新归来——
《紫塞秋风》新修版在原作的基础上加以改进并增添全新游玩要素重制后回归到玩家面前！
包括即时战斗玩法、特色武学系统，以及悬疑剧情、多线解谜融为一体的西部之旅的全面进化，
还原你记忆中的《紫塞秋风》并带来更多惊喜！

[b]《紫塞秋风》新修版官方预告片链接：
https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1hJ4m1b7RP/[/b]

《紫塞秋风》新修版调整了画面的色调、环境细节以及光影效果，力求更贴近真实、自然，在细节上进行填充，让山洞、岩窟或山林等场景更富沉浸感。此外，也对原作地图进行了全面重制升级，回归最初设计本心，更专注于体现场景的风貌。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/89dd19b487fdb1f7e223ca522da3c2ca8b658fa2.png[/img]

在《紫塞秋风》新修版中改动了原有敌人和Boss独特的动作和招式，玩家还将面对全新的敌人和Boss，全新强敌自然各有杀招，绝非易于之辈。毕竟西北之地，自古多出粗犷豪放好汉。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/f238c140a4108e065d9f6a864bd172a6cab0e9ca.png[/img]

《紫塞秋风》新修版将推出全新背刺机制以及穴位系统，并重制了原有的暗器系统。玩家只要在目标敌人的背后进行攻击即可发动背刺；当敌人出现时可以发射暗器攻击敌人，命中后会造成点穴、中毒或破防等效果。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/4b072b7f1b93d19d01af42995952151c9a029982.png[/img]

《紫塞秋风》中拥有丰富的武功招式和内功玩法，玩家可自由探索与组合，搭配出自己最熟悉、顺手的武功套路招式。而在《紫塞秋风》新修版中扩充了招式的升级内容、完善了其内功修炼界面、充实了内功玩法，玩家们可以更好地提升自己的战斗能力。

notes.title: 武林...总有人守着江湖！《紫塞秋风》新修版Demo即将上线！
notes.content:
[h3]【前言】[/h3]
江湖...从来没有那么简单！
三年前，与你们一路同行...
我说过，不会丢下你们。
对，这就是一言九鼎的武林中人！
今日，塞起秋风剑鸣沙。来...携手重新出发！

[h3]【入库】[/h3]
在《紫塞秋风》主页即可入库新修版Demo试玩
[b][u]目前处于版本审核阶段，待审核完成我们即刻上线！[/u][/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1264670/_/

首款中国西部武侠游戏《紫塞秋风》新修版重装上阵，玩法、画面，关卡地图等全面进化！
你记忆中的《紫塞秋风》又有新惊喜！你在，我在，一直在！
官方1群：955250933
官方2群：1094081501

[h3]【概述】[/h3]
跨越三年时光优化、打磨，再添诸多新要素升级归来！
本作在原作基础上进行了画质、UI以及视听体验的革新，并追加了丰富战斗体验的诸多游玩要素，例如一绝的穴位和暗器机制、强劲的背刺和处决终结特效、精深奥妙的内功加成以及招式升级等。保留原有西部武侠的基调下焕然一新，玩家将获得与原作截然不同的游戏体验！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/da940a044ad27710d70bd5f41385ac48bebc2e89.jpg[/img]
[h3]【亮点】[/h3]
[b]画面关卡[/b]
本作不仅提升了角色建模、场景以及光影效果等方面的画质表现，也重制了UI界面，通过更加精美的画质让玩家感受到更加身临其境的冒险体验，同时向玩家展示丝路文化，以此领略中国西北人文景观之美。关卡地图同样升级登场！地形结构重新制作，视觉效果全面翻新，这一改动和以往相比使得本作拥有了更丰富的环境特色，玩家需要在不同的关卡中探索环境的变化、运用不同的策略和技巧占据优势、最终战胜敌人，战斗的挑战性大大增加。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/910ac88859737ac849259a89a635277408da2ad8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/2283934497acabdc43d754bc672df467b43c3f86.jpg[/img]
[b]全新BOSS、难度选择[/b]
在《紫塞秋风》新修版中，玩家将面对全新的敌人和Boss，且原有敌人和Boss独特的动作和招式也进行了一定的改动，玩家需要运用智慧和勇气来战胜他们。本作也将开放简易、普通和困难三种游戏难度级别供玩家选择。在简单难度中敌人的伤害和复活条件比较宽松，玩家们都能轻松驾驭；在困难难度中玩家将面对更具挑战性的敌人，需要玩家精准把握破招反击的时机打败敌人，这对玩家的操作有一定要求。在给予玩家适当的难度来体验游戏的同时，也鼓励玩家继续挑战更高难度。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/5a7ed6dba054b6c39accdbdeb671d7c258843d4c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/d02a83c80e9da4ce630733fab5d8d9419cb4c7e6.jpg[/img]
[b]穴位、暗器、背刺机制[/b]
本作增设全新背刺机制、穴位系统并重制了原有的暗器系统。在战斗过程中，玩家只要在目标敌人的背后进行攻击即可发动背刺，此时还会触发特殊动画效果。玩家可根据特殊动画效果的提示完成后续的QTE，达成额外的伤害和终结效果。频繁且熟练地使用背刺来打击敌人，也能帮助玩家快速、高效地终结战斗。而穴位和暗器系统需要玩家具备充足的经验和实力，灵活运用来为自己服务。玩家可以根据自己的战斗需求和策略来选择不同的暗器，暗器命中后会造成点穴、中毒或破防等效果。当敌人出现时，你可以发射暗器，攻击敌人，远距离造成伤害或是控制敌人，能让战斗变得更有利。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/d972cd664d139884e3879bd3ea153895aa433588.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/dd8fd8520d6f1349cdcbab3f98f9951b54831474.jpg[/img]
[b]招式、内功系统[/b]
《紫塞秋风》中拥有丰富的武功招式且它们的形态各不相同，玩家可自由探索与组合，搭配出自己最熟悉、顺手的武功套路招式；还提供了八种不同的内功，对应八种完全不同的玩法，对于战斗、疗伤都各有不同。而在《紫塞秋风》新修版中扩充了招式的升级内容，包括基础的威力、爆发伤害以及特有的能力升级，其中，合理升级能力也是决定战斗成败的关键因素，让你在战斗中更加强大。还在保留原版内功系统的基础上完善了其内功修炼界面、充实了内功玩法。玩家可选择打通不同的气门经脉获得更为多样化的能力加成，玩家可以通过不断尝试和积累经验，根据自己的需求和玩法选择适合自己的成长路径，更好地提升自己的战斗能力。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/cb28a9a46e3399038cc02fafdeab62e26adf680f.jpg[/img]

Bug反馈QQ群：

notes.title: "The Wind Road" new expansion "Story of Hob Meat" free update is now online
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I'm Xiao Xudong, the producer of Wind Road. I'm sorry to have kept you waiting for a long time. In these two years, we have actually been silently listening to and reflecting on the suggestions and opinions given to us by players. And we seriously rectified many of the shortcomings in "Story of Meng Jing", and finally completed the "Story of Hob Meat".
Glad we're alive and taking a big step forward. This is a very bold attempt, I hope everyone will like it. We will continue to accept everyone's opinions and suggestions in the future, because "Wind Road" still has a long way to go. I personally will always stick to it, and our team will continue to develop more fun, new and free expansions to continue to serve "Wind Road". Please support us more.
Next, let me give you a brief introduction to the content of this key update:
I. Brand new expansion "Story of Hob Meat"
The initial flow of "Story of Hob Meat" is about 7 to 8 hours. It uses first-person action adventure, and the gameplay is roughly based on refreshing, passionate, collecting, solving puzzles, and other elements, among which combat elements include Insight, riposte, traps, sneak attacks, combos, weapon cooperation, execution and other elements.assassination and other elements, among which combat elements include demolition, defense, traps, sneak attacks, combos, weapon cooperation, execution and other elements.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/c31148c7c175cd19b1c0685e344b6ce885d4125b.jpg[/img]

[Story]
Through the exterior and interior relation, it tells the personal experience of chef Hob Meat in Ironback. Through the inextricable connection with Meng Jing and the whole "Wind Road" worldview, it shows that Hob Meat is not only a person with strong martial arts and personality defects, but also a vivid man in Jianghu. And some mysteries that have not been solved in the Story of Meng Jing will be revealed step by step in "Story of Hob Meat".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/c5bca8db42566d1ecf44302db9eea96ad9066695.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/1e5a8d21bd907078b07ee3d81a061174ad8a33c2.jpg[/img]

[Battle]
In terms of combat, since this game is played by a villain in the game, the combat system tends to be more refreshing, enriching gameplay on the basis of exhilaration, derived: different weapon switching combinations, light and heavy attack combos, sneak attack execution, death's door execution, active defense counterattack, skill defense counterattack and other gameplay, and combine level puzzle solving and combat skills.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/06fb809396f7340f695f4929c2d86a2d1aa9151b.jpg[/img]

[Weapon]
In "Story of Hob Meat", there are currently four types of weapons to choose. Each weapon has a different appearance upgrade effect, execution effect, heavy attack effect, skill combination effect, and feeling of hitting and exhilarating experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/f9f2b26c64081b17b7f762f5364edd8c5792f80c.jpg[/img]

[System]
This cultivation system adopts a fixed-point "altar". Upgrade, restore, and save games all need to be done at the "altar" in the scene. In addition to our weapons that can be upgraded, you can also upgrade basic attributes. However, you have to collect the items you need to improve your abilities. In addition to that, since Hob Meat practiced the Insanity Sutra, players can get up and continue fighting immediately after their defeat. At the same time, the playthrough inheritance system continues to be maintained. After clearing the game, you can continue to choose "New Story+" to unlock more than ten new achievements.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/2e9709258ff306a2ff709e5869e6abb11464f98a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/ed2c361959ac0139bebf1b9a7f3f8d958cc294a7.jpg[/img]

II. Story of Meng Jing
Based on the addition of new martial arts, new Inner Qi, and new equipment, we have optimized and adjusted the original edition game in all directions, basically optimized all codes, and now the game performance has been greatly improved. In addition to this, a game mini-map guide and navigation system, as well as a manual saving system have been added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/6a8fc3f7f6b112cc9b67d65e052944c76f2a1194.jpg[/img]

[Swordplay · Water-break Swordplay]
The exquisite swordplay technique recorded in the Sunflower Manual, both come from the same origin. The top technique is with no moves.  The inferior technique consists of six types of moves, with six variation in each move, that is a total of thirty-six moves.  The swiftness and strength are so incredible that it is extremely difficult to master this technique.
[Meteor Falling] Lean down to retreat into advance before a quick strike with the sword to damage the enemy.  It can interact with most of swordplay.
[Flying Swallow] Spin the sword to inflict multiple damage on the enemy to break through its defenses. Then turn to the back of the enemy and attack in the rear, like a swallow flying through the willow. A wonderful move with integrated offensive-defensive capability. It can interact with most of swordplay.
[Enlightenment] Meditate and swing the sword to deal massive damage to enemies in front. It can interact with most of swordplay.
[Flute on the River] Concentrates Qi on the sword and delivers attack to the enemies ahead,  dealing damage over time.
[Prosperity] Channel the Qi to your sword, and then quickly stab forward, making the enemies impossible to guard against.
[Ward Off the Evil] Condenses your qi into powerful shockwaves for both defense and offense.  Impeccable move to repel enemies. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/38540dbf2f8cf46af01c25cc68dcfa27748c1783.jpg[/img]

[Fist · Shadow Palm]
Famous Yin affinity palm martial arts created by Huo Yuntian when he observed the clouds in Maijishan Grottoes.  It needs Qi of Yin affinity to use, but fierce and furious in power.  It will show its true strength when combined with water.
[Free Flow] Deliver water-flow like palm martial arts to attack the enemies ahead. [Moon Palm] Push out with both palms to attack the enemy when they are not prepared, dealing double damage to the enemy in front.
[Overcast] Gather your strength and Qi on your palms, then deliver violent attacks to the enemies ahead. Gains 1 energy.
[Sea of Clouds] Condenses Qi into water flow and release it with your palms. This skill is just like the rolling seas. Gain 1 energy.
[Raincloud Palm] Gather the inner Qi to push out powerful energy like incoming storm with water flow on the palms to damage the enemy. Gain 1 energy.
[Earth-shattering] Control the water and drive it all around your body, then attack the enemy in front of you with great power. Gain 1 energy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/13235dac0cf223dd61f20affa3b9d1eeb3422099.jpg[/img]

[Inner Qi · Sunflower Manual]
The Sunflower Manual is written by a loving couple,  Li Dianzhi and Ouyang Kui.  It is an radical and extensive Yin style martial art rumored  to be closely connected with Violet Mist.
 It also can increase Strength significantly and makes you immune to internal injuries. Inner Qi Effect: Attacks have a chance to trigger [Psi-Sword] or [Shockwave]. Deals damage to enemies nearby and shatters their defenses. [Unity] Increases the overall skill damage of Yin affinity. [Nephelo] Gains [Ripples] effect when useing Water-break Swordplay. [Unrestraint] Immune to Qinggong Ban. Guaranteed crits of Hidden Weapon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/c603d0f6919de0bdbc0ed3e678b829bfeb858504.jpg[/img]

[Equipment]
[Waterbreaker] Ouyang Kui's sidearm, it makes the droplet sound when wielding. With the fast Water-break Swordplay, it leaves the cut as if it was scraped through by the rain. When Break effect triggers, you can use any swordplay moves in succession. If applied with the Inner Qi Methods of Sunflower Manual after wearing it, and the qi and blood are full, it increases the damage of the Water-break Swordplay when Health is full.
[Liuhe Peptachord] "The best among the many instruments." It was made of Chinese parasol which was found by Fu Xi when he saw a phoenix standing on it. Reduces the cooldown of Psi-Sword and Shockwave of Sunflower Manual. Increases the chance of triggering Psi-Sword and Shockwave.
[Illumina] Hair ornament Ouyang Kui made for Li Dian. When they visited Bingling Temple, an eminent monk helped imbue it with divine energy. Reduces the cost of Water-break Swordplay when equipped with Sunflower Manual and health is full
[Invincible Suit] Ouyang Kui's exclusive clothing, made of superior brocade, close-fitting breathable. Looks graceful when you put it on.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/06f6f1311acec79ac7bbbbcd107d1696e89b2996.jpg[/img]

[System]
When optimizing the original edition game, we put players’ suggestions first, and put a lot of effort into guiding and saving. We also improves the performance of the game and the stability of the system.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/d0e1bc58112de7cc5ea48768147619ebdb749849.png[/img]

III. Detailed list of updates
[Major Updates]
· New expansion "Story of Hob Meat" can be experienced in "DLC".
· Optimized the engine to improve overall game stability and performance.
· Rewrote some code to improve game performance by about 20%-30% in full-screen mode.
· Added a new saving system for Story of Meng Jing.
· Added a map navigation guide system for Story of Meng Jing.
· Pre-load the art resources for the new Roguelike level "Fire Prison".
[New system]
· Added an anniversary gift package.
· Added a new main menu.
· Added the Story of Hob Meat.
· Added updated appendix content.
· Added save & load file list.
· Added the menu saving function in Story of Meng Jing.
· Added the map navigation function in Story of Meng Jing.
· Added text instructions for main menu guidance.
[Added martial arts in Story of Meng Jing]
· Added Inner Qi "Sunflower Manual"
· Added Fist "Shadow Palm"
· Added Swordplay "Water-break Swordplay".
[Added equipment in Story of Meng Jing]
· Added equipment "Waterbreaker".
· Added equipment "Liuhe Peptachord".
· Added equipment "Illumina Headwear".
· Added equipment "Invincible Suit"
[Cancel to remove]
Cancel to remove the collection of the previous version of "Limited-time Martial Arts".
Cancel to remove the "Enlightening Pill" on the Casual difficulty.
[Optimization]
· Optimized the overall code to improve the frame rate.
· Optimized the crash chance of the game.
· Optimized the engine graphics API to improve the overall game performance.
[Bugs]
· Fixed some text errors.
· Fixed the bug in Story of Meng Jing  reported by players.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/8da53118a0c610ee86c26a122cac277e56bbd376.jpg[/img]

Thank you all for your support and waiting along the way. The development of "Story of Hob Meat" has come to an end, but another new expansion of "Wind Road" is about to start. I hope everyone will support and encourage us a lot. I believe that through our efforts, we will make "Wind Road" even better.
Official QQ Group: 1094081501
Please send me a private message for bug feedback.

notes.title: 紫塞秋风 大型DLC“滚刀肉”宣传片发布 将免费更新
notes.content:
致热爱《紫塞秋风》的各位玩家朋友：
大家好！
首先向热爱《紫塞秋风》的各位玩家致以深深的谢意，感谢各位对紫塞的喜爱与鞭策，让我们在发售至今这一年的时间内能够有动力，有方向地去对游戏进行调整和制作新的内容。值此万物蓬勃生长的夏季，我们热切地想向大家宣布一个好消息——大型DLC“滚刀肉”篇章将在近期与大家见面！
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/1958c400101037804de5a35b9545aa78a3c8270b.png[/img]
此次的“滚刀肉”篇章，我们为其设计了一套全新的故事线为游戏本体的故事内容进行了补充，故事的时间线与孟荆在铁背鱼客栈的时间线一致，此次，玩家朋友们可通过滚刀肉的第一人称视角，获悉与“滚刀肉”这一人物相关的隐秘剧情，揭示出“二娘”鞠灵亦的个人秘密以及“铁背鱼”所不为人知的一面，更可与孟荆一较高下！
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/df210483bd589cbf7690607cdc794d1d4fd2cb24.jpg[/img]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/266b8b6c5b2cc44ac2d11eb7a16853af13f05bde.jpg[/img]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/7bbe6a8161e4136ba61cbacc98f72fbf66bc5087.jpg[/img]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/42b5eb0ed202370b9fbe36a8dc7b4f8afadf78d4.jpg[/img]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/2c36f693b4354af42836df6c40d9b1bdb387cd77.jpg[/img]
除新增的故事线外，我们另外增添了大量的玩法内容，包含新战斗方式、新武器、新地图、新敌人等诸多内容。玩家可以在多种武器间自由切换，以不同的华丽武学技能击败敌人。除了可与敌人正面交锋外，玩家还可以选择从背后暗杀敌人、抵挡拆招反击、投掷可互动物品等充满技巧的对战方式，体验全新的游戏乐趣。
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/8eaecded552036bba22736a7f5941f53db58b110.jpg[/img]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/fca3b82fe6a41017564cf6122905d55fb283ab37.jpg[/img]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/8f0de857bc6979425a517fa1bd95d6035d94876b.jpg[/img]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/328a14d8e35c164f72faafc5426b6b730afa0067.jpg[/img]

 “不败套装”、新内功“葵典（阴属性）”、新武功“排影掌”、“辟水剑法”等全新的本体内容也将随滚刀肉DLC一并更新。
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/b64dec384a674c32a117eeb542db0cb8e817de18.jpg[/img]

《紫塞秋风》发行至今已近一年，在这一年的时间内我们也从未懈怠，制作组全体都一门心思得想要将这款游戏做好。对于游戏人来说，时间总是如同白驹过隙般眨眼就过，开发游戏的时候，不论给多少时间都觉得是不够用的。但，无论“滚刀肉”篇更新后，玩家们会给予怎样的反馈，我们都会以最赤诚的心来倾听。我们，下次更新见！

notes.title: Progress of DLC "Chapter of Hot Meat" and Exposures
notes.content:
Dear players, first of all, thank you very much for your support and love to "The Wind Road". Today we will report our development progress and breaking news to players and friends, and I believe it will be able to meet you in the near future! Please keep a little more patience and wait for a while!

The first thing I want to introduce to you is the first DLC "Chapter of Hob Meat". Hob Meat is a very important role in the game, and we have to take his personality into consideration when designing this character, so some changes have been made in the gameplay and level settings. In the chapter of Hob Meat , we will continue to talk about the secrets of "Insanity Sutra", the inner world where Meng Jing met in the Ironback Inn at the same time, and the secret of the dialogue between Ju Lingyi and Zhong Chenqing at the end of the chapter .

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h3][b] You (hob meat) will meet the newcomer Meng Jing in the Ironback Inn:[/b][/h3]

In addition to optimizing the original edition, we also added two sets of martial arts and a set of Inner Qi for Meng Jing, as well as the roguelike level of Flame Dungeon (introduced in the previous posted news). Today we will reveal some details of martial arts:

[h3][b] Added roguelike level Flame Dungeon, added the equipment of Seven-star Sword, Yin-Yang Bamboo Hat[/b][/h3]
In this challenging level, you have nothing but to collect the martial arts. If you feel that these things are not heroic, then you can also rush directly to the ultimate guard of the Flame Dungeon - the "Zhu Huangtian" known as the "Pig Emperor". Of course, as long as you are fast enough, maybe you can challenge the maximum score. Let's end the mess of the Flame Dungeon together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37040275/8673e2d18b00dc724abad829c66ac42216329eca.jpg[/img]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h3][b]Pictures of the development process:[/b][/h3]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Okay, that's all for today's exposures and work reports. I hope you will keep supporting "The Wind Road". [b][h3]In the future, no matter it is about more Moves/Martials Arts or DLC for other characters, we will persist and continue the development as always. [/h3][/b]Finally, I wish you all success in your work and good health! Keep good working on epidemic prevention! Thanks again everyone! Let's meet again in the DLC!

notes.title: "The Wind Road" FAQ
notes.content:
[b]Q: Where is the save data?[/b]
A: C:\\Users\\Use\\AppData\\LocalLow\\JIAYUAN\\The Wind Road.sav

[b]Q: Where is the backup save data? [/b]
A: My Files\\The Wind Road

[b]Q: The game is autosaved, but it hasn't saved to the local disk?[/b]
A: Please check if the file "Reg.exe" exists in the catalog: \\WINDOWS\\System32\\. If not, please download the system file "Reg.exe", and copy it to this catalog.

[b]Q: The fps is too low, how can I switch to discrete graphics when I have dual graphics?[/b]
A: Right-click the program you want to open, then move to run graphics processor, and select the high-performance.

[b]Q: Why does the "Not found the xxxx.dll" appear when I try to launch the game? [/b]
A: It could be due to the DirectX version being too low or the graphics driver being too low. You can install the latest DirectX program and update the graphics driver to solve this issue.

[b]Q: Why can't I find the game interface after I launch the Steam?[/b]
A: Try to run as an administrator.

[b]Q: Why does the mouse often move out of the window when the game is windowed?[/b]
A: Press ESC to bring out the menu, and back to the game with mouse-clicking, so that you can lock the mouse in the game.

[b]Q: What about the saving mechanics of the game?[/b]
A: We have added save points for the main and side missions. And in the following updates, we will add some save points for the important events and Boss fights

[b]Q: How can I lock the enemy in the game?[/b]
A: You can use Left Ctrl (Left Stick Button) to lock the enemy. A new enemy will be locked automatically after you get a kill. 

[b]Q: How can I switch or upgrade the Inner Qi?[/b]
A: Press TAB to select the Inner Qi, and cost 100 EXP to switch it. Click the "Learn" icon to upgrade it.

[b]Q: Will the game support a gamepad?[/b]
A: The Wind Road now supports all the gamepads except for PS4.

[b]Q: Will the game support gamepad customization?[/b]
A: We will add this function in the following updates.

[b]Q: Why can't I play the Arena Challenge?[/b]
A: Arena Challenge will be unlocked after one playthrough, and you can select it from the main menu > DLC.

[b]Q: Sometimes I will be confused by the mission guide or the puzzles.[/b]
A: We will optimize the mission description in the following updates. 

[b]Q: Will the mission flows and story be improved in the following updates? Some of them are a bit laggard?[/b]
A: We will optimize the game and level experience in the following updates.

[b]Q: Can I play The Wind Road without the network?[/b]
A: Of course, The Wind Road is a pure single game.
